meta.name: baoyu-url-to-markdown
meta.description: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using Chrome CDP. Supports two modes - auto-capture on page load, or wait for user signal (for pages requiring login). Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意网页转为 Markdown 格式保存
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把网页内容保存为 Markdown 格式
copy.tagline_en: Convert any webpage to Markdown format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to save web pages as Markdown

howto.what: Claude 能抓取任意网址，通过 Chrome 渲染后输出带标题、网址等元信息的 Markdown 文本，也可保存为文件。
howto.when: 当用户想把某个网页保存为 Markdown 时触发，例如要求“把链接转成 md”或“抓取这个页面”。

say.note: 自动抓取并输出 Markdown 文本。

say.text: 抓取这个链接，等页面就绪再转换
say.note: 脚本会提示按回车后才捕获。

say.text: 把链接转成 md 并保存为 output.md

howto.what_en: Claude can fetch a given URL via Chrome, render the page, and convert it to Markdown with metadata such as title and URL, optionally saving to a file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to save/convert a webpage to Markdown, such as 'save this page as md'.

say_en.note: Fetches the page and outputs Markdown.

say_en.text: Fetch this link and wait until the page is ready
say_en.note: Script prompts you to press Enter before capturing.

say_en.text: Convert the link to md and save as output.md
say_en.note: Saves to the default output directory.
